acceptance: Every documented `--platform-option` example in docs/ parses against its platform's registry, or is removed or replaced.
A test or lint fails when a doc example uses an unregistered key.
The decision per platform (register vs fix doc) is stated in the PR.
context: Defect found during the Spark tuning review (2026-09-30), requested as its own item by the user. The original research said table_format was not exposed in the CLI; that is only half true (the argparse flag exists, the platform option does not). Not a prerequisite for the Spark tuning items.
description:
Docs show `--platform-option` keys that the platform's option registry rejects, so copy-pasted commands fail. Checked with PlatformHookRegistry.parse_options (benchbox/core/hooks/platform_hooks.py) on 2026-09-30:
- spark accepts adaptive_enabled, driver_memory, java_home (list was truncated in the error text; re-run for the full set) but rejects table_format, shuffle_partitions and spark_config. The Spark argparse group defines --table-format and --shuffle-partitions (spark.py ~L298-312) and the config builder lists those fields (spark.py ~L825-845), so they exist as adapter config but are not reachable as platform options.
- pyspark-df and starburst: "does not accept platform-specific options", yet docs/platforms/pyspark-dataframe.md (L81, L130, L163, L218, L396) and docs/platforms/starburst.md (L111, L115, L175) use table_format / shuffle_partitions.
- databricks rejects table_format, yet docs/platforms/databricks.md (L73, L82) documents it and docs/advanced/format-conversion.md uses table_format=hudi.
- lakesail rejects table_format, shuffle_partitions, driver_memory, spark_config. velox accepts table_format, shuffle_partitions and driver_memory but not spark_config.
For each case decide, with the owner, whether to register the option or correct the doc; do not guess. Add a docs check (or test) that every `--platform-option key=` in docs/ is accepted by that platform's registry. Related: spark_config has no CLI route at all; arbitrary Spark settings go through the tuning item instead.
